**Confirmed finding (F2, executed):** the admin `snapshot` command's rate limiter is built with `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` at [Commands.java:766](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/admin/Commands.java:766), while the value it uses comes from `zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS` (default `300000`, i.e. milliseconds) and the sibling `RestoreCommand` uses `TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS`. `RateLimiter` converts through `unit.toMillis`, so the snapshot endpoint enforces 300 ms instead of the documented 5 minutes — an authenticated admin client can force whole-datatree snapshot streaming several times per second, defeating the documented protection. Reproduction with the production objects lives in [work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java) (`SnapshotCommand intervalInMs = 300` vs `RestoreCommand = 300000`; second request admitted again after 400 ms), command and output recorded in the report and `repro/out.txt`.

This turn's addition to that finding: the admin command suite was executed and passes anyway — `CommandsTest, CommandAuthTest, CommandResponseTest` → `Tests run: 42, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (execution `5ead762ee1714eeab4a781a0a9c2388d`) — because the test harness globally zeroes `zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS` (`ZKTestCase.java:102`, `common/ssl/Cert.java:63`) and no test asserts 429 behaviour; `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` also occurs exactly once in the entire main source tree, and both `new RateLimiter(...)` call sites read the same millisecond-typed setting.

**Rest of the audit record:** 239 test classes / 1805 tests executed through `isolated_exec`; the consensus/Zab, election, persistence and pipeline code reviewed against its documented contracts with no deviation found; one non-environmental failure (`QuorumPeerMainTest#testLeaderOutOfView`) reproduced, analysed and falsified as a test race on re-run; three environment blockers documented (hostname resolution in the sandbox `/etc/hosts` blocking the two FLE election tests and `ClientSSLTest`, external DNS for one `MultipleAddressesTest` case, and the need for `isolated_exec` because the plain shell cannot bind sockets). Leftover leads for any continuation are listed in §6 — chiefly an end-to-end two-request `/commands/snapshot` check with a non-zero interval, the unrunnable quorum-SSL/Kerberos/hammer classes, and the remaining 3.9.x fix-checklist items.
